using GeometryBasics

println("Testing Final Refactoring")
println("=" ^ 50)

# Test Point3f operations
println("\n1. Testing Point3f operations...")
p1 = Point3f(1.0, 2.0, 3.0)
p2 = Point3f(4.0, 5.0, 6.0)
println("   ✓ Point3f creation: $p1")
println("   ✓ Addition: $(p1 + p2)")
println("   ✓ Scalar mult: $(2.0 * p1)")

# Test Vector{Point3f}
println("\n2. Testing Vector{Point3f}...")
xyz = [Point3f(i, j, k) for i in 1:2 for j in 1:2 for k in 1:2]
println("   ✓ Created $(length(xyz)) points")
println("   ✓ First point: $(xyz[1])")
println("   ✓ Extract x: $([p[1] for p in xyz])")

# Test Point3{Int} for dimensions
println("\n3. Testing Point3{Int} for dimensions...")
n = Point3{Int}(10, 20, 30)
println("   ✓ Dimensions: $n")
println("   ✓ Access: nx=$(n[1]), ny=$(n[2]), nz=$(n[3])")

# Test type stability with functions
println("\n4. Testing type-stable function wrapper...")
function test_wrapper(point::Point3f, k::Point3f)
    return point + k
end
result = test_wrapper(Point3f(1,2,3), Point3f(4,5,6))
println("   ✓ Function result: $result")
println("   ✓ Result type: $(typeof(result))")

# Test reshape operations
println("\n5. Testing reshape with dimensions...")
xyz_flat = [Point3f(rand(3)...) for _ in 1:8]
n = Point3{Int}(2, 2, 2)
ux = [p[1] for p in xyz_flat]
ux_3d = reshape(ux, n[1], n[2], n[3])
println("   ✓ Reshaped to $(size(ux_3d))")
println("   ✓ Shape matches n: $(size(ux_3d) == (n[1], n[2], n[3]))")

println("\n" * "=" ^ 50)
println("✅ All tests passed!")
println("Refactoring to Vector{Point3f} is complete and working!")
